title: Logic for equipment sets using Visustella Equipset Bonus

posts.author: Arsyona
posts.body:
So uh.. i have a simple question but it will hurt your head the question are like this
Before we start im gonna explain a simple logic
Generally minus is negative (-) effect and plus (+) is positive effect
In general usually + is green and - is red
But in this case - is green and + is red
If you asking how? the logic are like this
Example using fire magic will cost you 10 MP (If you no have + or - equipment set)
But when you using the 4 set it will reduce your MP Cost -2% (Which mean more efficient) and it should be green color not red because it was positive buff
And we got this set, same set but it will cost you more MP Cost 2% (Which mean it will consume more of your mana)
So the logic are like this
If you using minus you will consume 9 mana but if you use plus you will consume 11 mana (Because base MP is 10)
The real question is
